Summary: MAP scrubber: change marks and clock-time ticks from saved formation history
Description: 1) Original intent: show on the MAP scrubber what changed and when. A mark on the scrubber line at each time a relationship's saved state changed (before -> after readable on hover), plus time ticks so a range like 'Oct 4 -> Oct 4' reads as real clock time. Founder 2026-10-05: make the record of change visible now, as a step toward a platform that accumulates and uses its own history. 2) Acceptance criteria: per formation_id, rows ordered by captured_at; a mark only where state differs from the preceding row of the same formation_id; hover shows both entities, relationship type, before -> after, captured_at; mark position = captured_at mapped linearly on the displayed history range (no interpolation or invented timestamps); ticks in viewer local time (hourly under 1 day, 12-hourly 1-7 days, daily beyond); no changes = ticks and no marks; no history = existing dimmed NO FORMATION HISTORY YET unchanged; palette only (STRENGTHENING lime, WEAKENING #007FFF, RECONFIGURATION #8A2BE2 diamond, others #e0e0dc); verified in Dev with seeded rows incl. a 77-relationship case and one real query, layout holds at 900/1400/1570 px. 3) Current implementation state: built in public/structure-field.html, committed 0dbef4c; released to Prod 2026-10-05 (main 2527796). Headless check at three widths done; the real-query Dev check and a browser check on Prod are still open. Every saved relationship so far has a single NEW row, so no real change exists in the data yet. Ticket filed late (draft approved by Founder GO 2026-10-05). 4) Dependencies: formation_state rows via /v1/formation-state; structurepanel.jsx posting formationHistory (unchanged); Prod engine stores history in a local file (Postgres unreachable from VPS) so Dev and Prod histories differ. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no; replaces the removed stacked-rows approach from KRYL-1357. 6) Maps to current product model: yes; presents saved structure and measured time differences, no prediction (section 21). Out of scope: conemap.jsx:20 maps WEAKENING to amber (noted, untouched). Draft: specs/ticket-draft-timeline-change-marks.md.
